body_findings.name: Simon Fraser Health Region
body_findings.scope: New alternative original host sfhr.com found via a period bibliography; original HTML hierarchy followed; linked PDFs retrieved where available; both retrieved SFHR PDFs structurally inspected with get_image_info including inline images and get_drawings. Selected relevant pages and artwork visually inspected.
body_findings.outcome: The original sfhr.com host and inter_ccaboutsfhr path were not the exhausted sfhr.bc.ca route. Health Profile 2000 and January 2001 Continuum PDFs recovered. Both use raster corporate logos; no native vector verified. One byte-preserved 435×219 colour websiteJPEG and one 1943×990 original one-bit newsletter image accepted as additional rasters.

sources.notes: 138-page thesis cites the SFHR Mental Health Services 1998–1999 annual report at http://www.sfhr.com/Inter_MentalHealth/profile/main.htm, retrieved December 18, 2002. Text citation inspected; thesis is a discovery route, not artwork evidence.
Names Simon Fraser Health Region and its Burnaby/New Westminster/Tri-Cities/Maple Ridge service area. Links About, Corporate Services and Regional News.

Links Health Profile 2000, Aboriginal profile, directional plan and four annual reports, including previously unrecovered 2000/2001 report. Exact linked documents except Health Profile were 404. Two once-decoded old annual-report forms also 404. A separate archive-availability request for the 2000/2001 annual report returned empty archived_snapshots.
Cover and appendix cover contain 68×34 bitmap logos (xrefs 2 and 5014); get_image_info verified. Full 205 pages structurally inspected. Cover visually inspected; no new vector.
July 1999 mental-health annual report is an HTML page with bitmap image references, not a downloadable native vector report.
Publications, standards/policies and services subpages linked from this original page all returned 404.
Linked three Healthful magazine PDFs, strategic-directions brochure, and Continuum index. Magazine/brochure requests all returned 404; known archives redirect for fall 1999 also ended 404.
Eight 2001 newsletter links attempted. January issue retrieved; seven other issues returned 404, including a redirect to archivedFebruary 2001 file that ended 404.

1943×990 one-bit mask xref 256 appears in running headers.139×71 colour masthead JPEG at xref 266 on page 1. get_image_info catches both; no vector corporate logo. Source uses TIFF images according to OPI metadata. January printed date overrides stale PDF title April 2000.

body_findings.archive_index_limit: Three distinct CDX catalogue scopes (broad domain, PDFs only and bounded About-path prefix) each returned 503. This is an access/retrieval failure, not evidence that no archived files exist. Direct archived links were followed instead.

body_findings.name: North Shore Health Region
body_findings.scope: Targeted original-domain/publication-title searches and bibliography review. No newly downloaded North Shore agency PDF successfully inspected in this pass.
body_findings.outcome: Period bibliography supplies specific 2000 health-services-plan and 2001 balanced-scorecard targets, but no original downloadable files recovered. A rediscovered Health Canada quality-plan report is already inspected in existing PR #9 and was excluded from new evidence.

sources.notes: Cites North Shore Health Region 2000 Health Services Plan for 2000–2003, Balanced Scorecard Version 1.1 (2001), and B. A. O’Connor Community Health Profile 2000. No logo verified from this page.
Citation to June 1997 North Shore Community Health Profile. Source file not downloaded or visually inspected in this pass.

Search service exposes 304-page Quest for Quality report and North Shore plan pp 138,279–291. Local retrieval returned archived-information notice HTML even after ordinary cookie/referrer following. Root confirmed existing PR #9 had already inspected actual PDF and found no agency mark. Not counted as a new document inspection.

body_findings.excluded_prior_evidence: November 1999 CJNS advertisement and trail donor-panel raster already known; nshr.hnet.bc.ca email-domain archive query already attempted in pass 3 and not repeated.

body_findings.name: Fraser Valley Health Region
body_findings.scope: Specific 2001 business-case search, public Internet Archive catalogue and item metadata review; no new artwork or source-PDF visual inspection.
body_findings.outcome: Located a 2001 business-case catalogue route. Internet Archive identifies its available version as microfiche. CanadaCommons describes an apparently related 114-page document, while IA describes xvii+182 pages; these versions were not assumed identical. No downloadable native source or verified new logo was recovered.

sources.notes: Title Business Case for the Fraser Valley Health Centre and Eastern Fraser Valley Cancer Centre; catalogue date February 8, 2001;114 pages and listed corporate authors. Direct web open returned 403. Page notes AI-enriched metadata. Actual file not inspected.

2001 business case, Fraser Valley Health Region et al.; Victoria: Health Services Group; source explicitly Microfiche. 200 scanned images and 28,990,150-byte generatedTextPDF listed. PDF itself not downloaded; no logo claim.
September 27, 2000 project-definition appendix, not established as the 2001 business case. Existing 78×78 FVHR emblem from its contents/cover file was not duplicated.

body_findings.name: Okanagan Similkameen Health Region
body_findings.scope: Targeted annual-report/original-domain/logo searches; no new source PDF downloaded or artwork visually inspected.
body_findings.outcome: Search found an additional 1999 newspaper notice naming the Region and a distinct Kelowna thesis citing 1999 OSHR policy. Neither source has been inspected as a potential vector; kept as unverified leads. Previously inspectedMQ 49217 and original oshr.org archive route were not repeated.

sources.notes: August 31, 1999 Similkameen News Leader issue. Search index identifies an OSHR logo in the Princeton Community Health Advisory Committee nomination notice. PDF not downloaded or visually/structurally inspected. No vector or improved-raster claim.
Breaking Down the Silos Towards... cites OSHR Corporate Vision April 1999 and Policy Manual AD 10. Different from already inspectedMQ 49217, but no document artwork was checked here.
